title: -5 / BLANK is -Infinity

source.supports: a BLANK denominator behaves as zero

source.quote: If the error is not intercepted, the division returns positive or negative infinity depending on the sign of the numerator, or NaN in case of 0 / 0
source.supports: what / gives for a zero denominator

derivation: The BLANK denominator is zero, as in 5/BLANK. The numerator is negative, so the result is negative infinity.
